thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Metering anomaly detected: emitter-prod count sag / delayed emits observed. Pager sent to #incidents. See attached signal: token_delta drop > 80% across multiple partitions.
jamie-oncall: taking pager, on it. any immediate customer impact?
alice-billing: we see delayed usage windows from 23:10 UTC onward. 2 customers temporarily triggered overage flags (acct_421, acct_777). Hold on credits until we confirm root cause.
bob-sre: looking at emitter logs now, seeing a flood of 503s to counter-service starting ~2026-03-16T23:11:40Z. quick tail:
```
2026-03-16T23:12:45Z emitter[prod] WARN send-failed 503 service=counter-service attempt=3
2026-03-16T23:12:30Z emitter.offset=1245789 last-emit=2026-03-16T23:12:30Z queued=0
2026-03-16T23:13:01Z emitter[prod] ERROR backpressure detected peers=3
```
carol-data: kafka side shows increased consumer lag on topic "usage-emits"; ~24 partitions with lag, max_lag=48k. looks like emitter retries caused spikes and broker throttling.
jamie-oncall: plan — 1) failover emitter routing to secondary path, 2) enable emitter backfill job, 3) temporarily suppress customer overage flags for affected accounts, 4) monitor counts and escalate if rollback needed. Assigning: @bob-sre do routing, @carol-data start backfill, @alice-billing handle suppression + credits. I will coordinate and update every 15m.
bob-sre: executing routing command now (will post output).
```
$ redwoodctl route set emitter prod --target secondary --reason "mitigation: 503s to counter-service" --until 2026-03-17T01:00Z
OK: route updated, traffic shifting 100% -> emitter-secondary
```
incident-bot: Action recorded: route change by bob-sre at 2026-03-16T23:18:07Z.
carol-data: starting backfill job for windows 2026-03-16T22:00 -> 2026-03-17T00:30 to catch late emits. Command:
```
$ python infra/tools/backfill_usage.py --start "2026-03-16T22:00" --end "2026-03-17T00:30" --emit --priority high
Backfill queued (job_id=bf-20260316-23-01)
```
alice-billing: created temporary suppression rule: billing.overage.suppress for acct_421, acct_777 until 2026-03-18T00:00Z. Will not auto-credit yet, will reconcile after backfill. :white_check_mark:
dmitri-oncall: I'm due to take night oncall at 23:30 UTC, will join and take handoff at that time. please ping me here when you're handing off.
jamie-oncall: handing off to @dmitri-oncall at 23:30 UTC. current state: route switched -> emitter-secondary; backfill started; suppression applied. estimated affected customers=~12, flagged customers=2. estimated token undercount ~1.2M tokens (preliminary).
dmitri-oncall: thanks — taking over. I'll monitor emitter metrics, kafka lag, and the backfill job. please DM if anything urgent.
bob-sre: verifying counts after failover, seeing emitter rate recover to normal within 30s. metric snapshot: tokens_emitted/sec back to baseline 12k->11.8k.
carol-data: backfill job progress: 10% complete, processing historical slices, no errors so far (job_id=bf-20260316-23-01). ETA ~50m.
ops-billing: customer impact summary for support: ~12 customers saw delayed usage; 2 customers hit temporary overage flags (acct_421, acct_777) — suppression applied. Prepare customer comms template?
jamie-oncall: yes — draft comms: "We experienced delayed usage reporting between 23:10–23:40 UTC which caused temporary overage alerts for a small number of customers. We have applied temporary suppressions and are backfilling usage; we will reconcile and credit where appropriate. Expected resolution within 2 hours."
alice-billing: I'll prepare credits worksheet and run final recon after backfill completes. Will attach to this thread.
bob-sre: adding firewall rule tweak we applied earlier that may have impacted counter-service connections — reverted that change at 23:15 UTC. CLI: `tf apply -target=module.egress_fix` — revert completed.
incident-bot: Note: config change revert by bob-sre recorded.
carol-data: backfill 40% complete; kafka lag falling (now 6 partitions lagging, max_lag=3k).
dmitri-oncall: monitoring logs, no new 503 spikes. will escalate if any regression.
ops-billing: collecting affected account list and preliminary credit estimates; sending to support for triage.
jamie-oncall: thanks team — I'm leaving the handoff with @dmitri-oncall. please continue updates here. I'll post a short postmortem stub after resolution. :thumbsup:
alice-billing: initial credits sheet uploaded to /shared/billing/recon/mitigation_1725009999.csv — I'll update when backfill finishes.
bob-sre: final check — emitter metrics stable for 12m, route still on secondary, no new errors.
carol-data: backfill finished successfully (job_id=bf-20260316-23-01). reconciled ~1.25M tokens.
ops-billing: re-run of billing pipeline shows overage flags cleared after ingest. will run final audit and apply credits.
dmitri-oncall: closing pager; monitoring for 1hr then will clear incident. thanks everyone.
alice-billing: credits prepared and will be applied in next batch, support notified. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident closed by dmitri-oncall at 2026-03-17T00:10:50Z. Postmortem assigned to jamie-oncall (owner) and bob-sre, carol-data, alice-billing as contributors.
